{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive{/c}: {if:SF_22}{c_important}Laalish{/c} seeks enemies and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c}, and a {c_number}[SF_3*100|%|]{/c} {c_important}Slow{/c} to Close enemies that lingers for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds.{else}{c_important}Laalish{/c} seeks enemies and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and a {c_number}[SF_3*100|%|]{/c} {c_important}Slow{/c} to Close enemies that lingers for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds.{/if} When you attack enemies, it moves through the abyss to bite them, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_BITE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_label}Active{/c}: {if:SF_22}{c_important}Command{/c} {c_important}Laalish{/c} to create a Terror Realm for {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} seconds, applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c}, and a {c_number}[SF_18*100|%|]{/c} {c_important}Slow{/c} to enemies within.{else}{c_important}Command{/c} {c_important}Laalish{/c} to create a Terror Realm for {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} seconds, applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and a {c_number}[SF_18*100|%|]{/c} {c_important}Slow{/c} to enemies within.{/if} {c_important}Laalish{/c} devours enemies within Terror Realm, dealing {c_number}{payload:TERROR_REALM_IMPACT}{/c} damage every {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} second.

While you are within Terror Realm, gain {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} every {c_number}[{SF_15}|2|]{/c} seconds.
